newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start mixed to lower, trade cautious.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start mixed to lower, trade cautious.

text.p: UK shares started mixed to lower on Tuesday as a scarcity of corporate news and concerns about a possible near-term interest rate hike kept many institutional players on the sidelines, dealers said.
"People are back from their holidays but few want to do any serious business at the moment. There just isn't any reason," the head of trading at a large brokerage said.
"This market is just going to drift around a bit this morning and wait for Wall Street."
The FTSE 100 index was down 2.6 points at 4,103.9 by 0840 GMT while the March FTSE futures eased 6.0 points to 4,110.0.
